name: PingVid
author: Devnet

sections.description:
PingVid is a lightweight WordPress plugin that displays floating videos on your website to help promote products, announcements, special offers, events, and other important messages.

The video appears in a corner of the screen and starts playing automatically without sound, allowing visitors to continue browsing without interruption. When clicked, the video expands and can play with sound, creating an engaging experience without the intrusive behavior of traditional popups.

PingVid supports YouTube Shorts, standard YouTube videos, and self-hosted video files, making it easy to showcase promotional content anywhere on your site.

Perfect for:

  • Product launches
  • Special offers and promotions
  • Black Friday campaigns
  • Store announcements
  • Product demos
  • Event promotions
  • Video testimonials
  • Welcome messages

DOCUMENTATION

Features

  • Floating video widget
  • Supports YouTube Shorts
  • Supports standard YouTube videos
  • Supports self-hosted videos
  • Autoplay playback with muted sound
  • Expand video on click
  • Responsive design
  • Close button
  • Lightweight and easy to configure

Pro Features

Upgrade to PingVid Pro and unlock advanced targeting and customization options:

  • Assign videos to individual posts, pages, and products
  • Support for custom post types
  • Different videos for different content
  • Custom initial video size
  • Minimize button
  • Option to prevent visitors from closing the video
  • Additional display controls and customization options

Support

We’re here to help. Feel free to open a new thread on the Support Forum.

Reviews

It’s funny how much joy all those 5-star reviews bring to our team. It really keeps us going and motivates us to bring more cool features.
If you like this plugin, feel free to leave a review.

sections.installation:
Installation from within WordPress

  1. Visit Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for PingVid.
  3. Install and activate the PingVid plugin.

Manual installation

  1. Upload the entire pingvid folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Visit Plugins.
  3. Activate the PingVid plugin.

After activation

Visit the new PingVid > Settings menu.
sections.faq:
Does PingVid support YouTube Shorts?

Yes. PingVid supports YouTube Shorts as well as standard YouTube videos.

Can I use self-hosted videos?

Yes. You can use self-hosted video files in addition to YouTube videos.

Will the video autoplay?

Yes. Videos autoplay muted when supported by the visitor’s browser and device.

Can visitors close the floating video?

Yes. Visitors can close the video widget at any time.

Does PingVid work on mobile devices?

Yes. PingVid is fully responsive and works on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

Can I display different videos on different pages?

This feature is available in PingVid Pro. The free version displays a single global video across your website.

Can I use PingVid with custom post types?

Yes. PingVid Pro supports posts, pages, products, and custom post types.

Can I change the video size?

Advanced video sizing and additional customization options are available in PingVid Pro.

Where can I find the documentation?

Documentation is available at:
https://devnet.hr/docs/pingvid/

Where can I get support?

You can open a support thread in the WordPress.org support forum, and we’ll be happy to help.
